feed.title: Open MPC - Plugin Catalog: new releases
feed.rights: Plugin list data from OpenMPC (https://open-mpc.github.io), licensed CC BY 4.0. Reuse terms: catalog/README.md

entry.title: πToniC 1.1.2
entry.summary: A Microtonic-inspired drum machine. πToniC features 8 independent drum voices, each combining filtered noise with a morphing oscillator or WAV sample playback. Its sound engine includes pitch modulation, amplitude envelopes, drive, EQ and individual voice controls. Shared stereo reverb and tempo-synced delay complete the engine.

entry.title: πClideaN 1.4.1
entry.summary: Sixteen-lane hybrid MIDI sequencer with Euclidean patterns, per-step expression, scales, selective randomization and dual-LFO modulation.

entry.title: Sturm-TP 0.1.3
entry.summary: Six-voice analog-style drum and synth voice modelled on the Tempest drum machine: two analog and two sample oscillators, lowpass and highpass filters, five envelopes, two LFOs, eight mod paths, kit mode, distortion, compressor and delay. Bank browser with Q-Links; loads its SysEx dumps.

entry.title: PROPHETIC 6 1.0.4
entry.summary: A port of the PROPHET 67 firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1: a Prophet-6-style 7-voice analogue poly with two oscillators (sub, noise, sync, poly mod), a high-pass into a resonant 4-pole low-pass, two LFOs, distortion, chorus, delay, five reverbs, an arp on the MPC tempo and a low split. HIGH and ECO quality for the CPU. Panel-style touch pages.

entry.title: Profit-5 3.0.2
entry.summary: Five-voice analog polysynth modelled on an early SSM-chip classic: two oscillators, a four-pole resonant filter, Poly-Mod, wheel-mod, glide and unison, 38 factory programs, a Rev 2 / Rev 4 voicing switch, and an importer for Repro-5 .h2p patches.

entry.title: Profit-5 3.0.1
entry.summary: Five-voice analog polysynth modelled on an early SSM-chip classic: two oscillators, a four-pole resonant filter, Poly-Mod, wheel-mod, glide and unison, 38 factory programs, a Rev 2 / Rev 4 voicing switch, and an importer for Repro-5 .h2p patches.

entry.title: Profit-08 2.0.3
entry.summary: Eight-voice, two-layer analog-style synthesizer: stack and split layers, a gated sequencer and arpeggiator, a resonant 2/4-pole filter, and a banks browser with favourites for your own program and bank SysEx dumps. 2.0 adds a native MPC screen with large knobs and Q-Link control of every page.

entry.title: Plugin Manager App 2.1.0
entry.summary: The Open MPC Plugin Manager as an app: a Plugin Manager tile in MENU, full screen with its own tabs, instead of a plugin on a track. Patches MPC while it loads (only on the exact MPC OS 3.10.1 build it was made for; anything else is left alone). Installing it also installs Addin Restore so it survives a reboot.

entry.title: OxZygen 0.8.0
entry.summary: A dark, cinematic instrument: choirs, winds, brass, strings, bells, piano, e-piano, harp, mallets, synths and textures from CC0 recordings, in two layered slots with filter, lo-fi, tempo-synced delay and motion, reverb and sub. 200 presets with a browser page; a CRT orb reacts as you play. Also a VST3 for Mac and Windows and an Audio Unit for Mac.

entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager 2.1.0
entry.summary: The official OpenMPC plugin manager for Gen1 and Gen2 MPCs (32-bit build for Force, Live, One, X, Key; 64-bit for the Live III and kin). Browse this catalog and install, update and remove plugins on the MPC itself, with rollback if an install fails. Built on poloq's mpc-vst-manager.

entry.title: MPC Template Chooser 1.0.2
entry.summary: Replaces Demos on the New Project screen with templates from the /Templates folder on each drive. Installs a startup hook that rewrites the system file /sdcard/Demos/NewProjectDialog.json. Requires the Open MPC boot-reload service and MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. Tested on an original MPC X.

entry.title: MPC Skipback 0.6.4
entry.summary: Records the main output all the time and saves the last 30 to 60 seconds as a WAV when you double-press a hardware button (Rec Arm on a Force; Overdub, or a button you teach it, on other models). Tested on a Gen1 Force; other models are unverified.

entry.title: Morpho-PE 1.0.3
entry.summary: Four-voice synthesizer modelled on the Poly Evolver's voice: analog-style and digital waveshape oscillators, 2/4-pole lowpass, delay, feedback, distortion, 4 x 16 step sequencer, a bank browser and a touchscreen skin with Q-Links. Loads Poly Evolver program dumps and, from your own Prophet VS ROM chip images, the 95 factory waves.

entry.title: MIDI Transport 1.0.2
entry.summary: Map MIDI notes or CCs to MPC transport and hardware buttons with per-project MIDI Learn and Momentary or Toggle modes. Requires Open MPC Remote. Tested on an original MPC X.

entry.title: Maze Voice 2.0.1
entry.summary: Monophonic Moog Labyrinth-style thru-zero oscillator, wavefolder and state-variable filter voice with two LFOs, a page randomiser and a three-page touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

entry.title: Maze Sequencer 2.0.1
entry.summary: Dual 8-step generative sequencer (Moog Labyrinth style) with corrupt, scale quantising, two LFOs and per-line MIDI channels, driving other tracks over MIDI.

entry.title: Lucky Dip 1.0.1
entry.summary: A random 16-pad drum-kit builder and inspiration machine: dips into your sample library, fills the pads at random, plays the kit and exports it as an MPC drum program.

entry.title: Frodhes 0.9.14
entry.summary: A physically modelled electric piano, vibraphone and marimba, with no samples: 16 voices, 57 presets, drive, chorus, phaser, tremolo, wah, delay, reverb, EQ and a compressor.

entry.title: Crate Digger 2.2.1
entry.summary: Dig for records by genre, style, decade, region and country on Discogs, then stream and play them into an MPC track, with its own screen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: Argevox Gerät 1.0.0 (beta)
entry.summary: 20-band live vocoder inspired by the Sennheiser VSM-201, with a voice gate, de-esser, and touch-adjustable band levels. Routes the carrier and microphone into opposite channels of a stereo submix.

entry.title: Sculpt 1.0.0
entry.summary: A sculpting sampler and looper. Stretch, slice, reverse and granulate samples, filter them into harmonic tones, and add grit and warmth. Send them through chorus, echo and big reverbs. Sync to the beat or let them drift like tape.

entry.title: REV-246 1.0.1
entry.summary: tehguitarist's REV-246, a vintage mid-80s style digital reverb: five programmes, 16-bit storage, transformer, ducker, true stereo or the original mono-in routing.

entry.title: Profit-5 3.0.0
entry.summary: Five-voice analog polysynth modelled on an early SSM-chip classic: two oscillators, a four-pole resonant filter, Poly-Mod, wheel-mod, glide and unison, 38 factory programs, a Rev 2 / Rev 4 voicing switch, and an importer for Repro-5 .h2p patches.

entry.title: Omni Sampler 2.3.0
entry.summary: Multi-format sampler: plays Akai, E-mu, Roland, Kontakt/Maschine, SF2 and SFZ instruments straight from their files or sampler disk images, with layers, keyswitching, a mod matrix and its own screen skin.

entry.title: Nepenthe 1.0.2
entry.summary: Amalgamated Signals' smooth velvet-noise reverb, bit-identical to the original, with time, pre-delay, bass, treble, width and mix on upstream's sliders.

entry.title: Jamiro 1.1.2
entry.summary: Novation X-Station-style polysynth (KS engine): 8 voices, 3 oscillators with sync, FM and ring mod, multimode filter, 2 envelopes, 2 LFOs, arpeggiator and effects. Loads your own X-Station/KS .syx banks from Content/Banks. Independent project, not affiliated with Novation.

entry.title: Downrush 0.1.1
entry.summary: A polyphonic synth running the synth engine of the open-source Deluge community firmware 1.3.0: subtractive, FM and ring mod, sample oscillators, a 24-cable mod matrix, arpeggiator, and it loads and saves Deluge SYNTH preset files. Needs MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. Tested on a Force.

entry.title: Costello Reverb 1.0.2
entry.summary: Sean Costello's 8-line FDN reverb (Soundpipe revsc, as in AudioKit's CostelloReverb), bit-identical to the original, with low cut, high cut, verb size, mix and output.

entry.title: Audity '78 0.2.0
entry.summary: Wavetable synth: two morphing oscillators, SSM2040-style filters, chorus, delay, reverb. 16 sounds. Bright tables alias on high notes.

entry.title: AMGR 0.2.5
entry.summary: Four-layer granular sample mangler in the spirit of the Tasty Chips GR-2, aimed at much lower resource consumption. Touch a layer's waveform to set where its grains spawn from: per-layer ADSR, density/size/spread/jitter/reverse, a CPU-safety governor, a file browser per layer, a factory bank that varies every parameter, delay and reverb.

entry.title: Warpline 1.2.0
entry.summary: Wavetable synth for standalone MPC built on the open-source Vital engine: plays .vital patches (add your own in <drive>/Warpline/Patches), 360 factory patches with genres, search and favourites, a wavetable picker, a generative 16-step arpeggiator, GRAINZ granular FX and a 16-slot mod matrix with random sources.

entry.title: VHS Vibes 1.8.0
entry.summary: A worn video-tape effect: pitch wobble, tape saturation with tape hysteresis, the Hi-Fi track, generation loss, B-type noise reduction, hum, hiss and crackle, plus deck faults (level control, drift, tracking dropouts, a tilted head) and a dry/wet mix. 54 programs, on a hot pink cassette with reels that turn and a picture that shows the sound.

entry.title: VARIANT 0.1.2
entry.summary: MIDI-only dual generative 8-step sequencer: two self-mutating sequences with a bit pattern per step, randomizer with seeds, undo/redo and evolve, 16 scales, chain mode, pattern buffer, probability, ratchet and swing. Plays other tracks over its own MIDI port. 128 presets, 3 pages. MPC OS 3.x.

entry.title: REV-246 1.0.0
entry.summary: tehguitarist's REV-246, a vintage mid-80s style digital reverb: five programmes, 16-bit storage, transformer, ducker, true stereo or the original mono-in routing.

entry.title: PlateauXXL 0.5.0 (beta)
entry.summary: Valley Audio's Plateau reverb from VCV Rack, patched: every CV input on a built-in source (four Bogaudio LFOs, Tidal Modulator 2, Random Sampler, step and gate sequencers) synced to the MPC tempo, a brickwall limiter, Panic and 16 presets, each page drawn like its module. 32-bit and 64-bit MPCs.

entry.title: Osirus 1.0.0
entry.summary: An emulation of the Access Virus A, B and C synthesizers' original firmware (gearmulator's DSP56300 emulator) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin, your own SysEx banks (sub-folders too), named favourites, RANDOM, Q-Link control and knob values on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Virus ROM.

entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager 2.0.0
entry.summary: The official OpenMPC plugin manager for Gen1 and Gen2 MPCs (32-bit build for Force, Live, One, X, Key; 64-bit for the Live III and kin). Browse this catalog and install, update and remove plugins on the MPC itself, with rollback if an install fails. Built on poloq's mpc-vst-manager.

entry.title: Nepenthe 1.0.1
entry.summary: Amalgamated Signals' smooth velvet-noise reverb, bit-identical to the original, with time, pre-delay, bass, treble, width and mix on upstream's sliders.

entry.title: Mini-JV 2.0.4
entry.summary: An emulation of the Roland JV-880 sample-based sound engine as a native instrument, with the original reverb and chorus, a Play page with eight macros and a touchscreen skin.

entry.title: GeonKick 1.0.0
entry.summary: Gen2 MPC percussion synth with 16 pad sounds, nine oscillators per sound, touch-editable envelopes, WAV import and preview, and 118 native presets/kits. Hardware tested on Live III; MPC OS 3.10.1 or newer.

entry.title: Costello Reverb 1.0.1
entry.summary: Sean Costello's 8-line FDN reverb (Soundpipe revsc, as in AudioKit's CostelloReverb), bit-identical to the original, with low cut, high cut, verb size, mix and output.

entry.title: Costello Reverb 1.0.0
entry.summary: Sean Costello's 8-line FDN reverb (Soundpipe revsc, as in AudioKit's CostelloReverb), bit-identical to the original, with low cut, high cut, verb size, mix and output.

entry.title: OP3000 1.0.1
entry.summary: Dual-chip FM synth in the style of the YM2151 and YM2612, with a PSG sub-chip, filter, chorus and delay.

entry.title: MS20XXL 0.2.0
entry.summary: Korg MS-20-style semi-modular mono synth, circuit-modelled from the MS-20 schematics: the KLM-307 (MK2) and KORG35 (MK1) filter boards solved from their circuit equations, Hz/V sockets. Every MS-20 patch jack in its place, normalled like the hardware, patched by touch; an SQ-10-style sequencer; 63 patches with cables. 32-bit and 64-bit MPCs.

entry.title: MPC Template Chooser 1.0.1
entry.summary: Replaces Demos on the New Project screen with templates from the /Templates folder on each drive. Installs a startup hook that rewrites the system file /sdcard/Demos/NewProjectDialog.json. Requires the Open MPC boot-reload service and MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. Tested on an original MPC X.

entry.title: MPC Sample Rack 1.0.1
entry.summary: Add, remove and turn on or off the plugins in a project's inserts from a RACK page on the Sample. APPLY saves and restarts MPC: save first.

entry.title: MPC Looper 0.6.1
entry.summary: Experimental four-loop stereo insert for MPC OS 3.10.1+. Disk-backed recording up to 32 bars, overdub, undo, tempo sync and Warp, per-loop stop timing, and separate WAV exports. Fixed audio caches; final revision and Gen2 are offline-only.

entry.title: MPC AirLink 1.3.0
entry.summary: Receive classic AirPlay or VBAN audio on an MPC plugin track. Physical-style UI, gain on Q-Link 1, fixed 24 Hz meters and a 120 ms default VBAN buffer. ARMv7/AArch64; MPC OS 3.10.1+.

entry.title: Mono-101 0.5.1
entry.summary: A circuit-modelled SH-101 mono synth: a port of the Lemus engine, which solves the original schematic part by part, modified for the MPC. The manual's 40 sample sounds, user presets named on screen, and a Circuit Bent page based on Nova-mod and more (PWM, triangle VCO, overdrive, VCF FM, LFO range, key trigger, tempo sync). Gen2 only, CPU heavy.

entry.title: MIDI Transport 1.0.1
entry.summary: Map MIDI notes or CCs to MPC transport and hardware buttons with per-project MIDI Learn and Momentary or Toggle modes. Requires Open MPC Remote. Tested on an original MPC X.
